name: Databricks Model Serving and Feature Store
sku: Model Serving and Feature Store in Unity Catalog, as included in the Databricks platform. Documentation reviewed on the AWS docs site.

serve.ml-serving.note: Model Serving deploys custom MLflow models and foundation models as REST endpoints for real-time and batch inference, autoscaling on serverless compute. Databricks quotes over 25K queries per second with under 50 ms overhead latency.

transform.feature-eng.note: A central feature registry in Unity Catalog. Features are defined declaratively as feature views or as Delta tables, with point-in-time joins for training sets, an online store with millisecond reads and automatic feature lookup at inference.

presentation.tagline: Feature registry and real-time model endpoints governed in Unity Catalog.
